verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of a SaaS product like cfo.ai, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server, a tools doc page, and a `claude mcp add` setup command. Those are adjacent agent-integration features, not an explorable API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe found 404s at every candidate path, and the docs say no API keys are issued, so there is no evidence of a runnable API explorer.
